about: s1e02 first edit (S13 Editor, 26 Nov; clarity scripts). Per-episode choices only; the shared toolchain is production/scripts/episode/.
notes: cut_on_word copied from shots.json edit_notes_for_episode_editor (S7 clarity remap): l15 s16/s17 on 'ग्यारह'/'The' (D-025 item 4: l15 starts on Aditya, the speaker), l28 s31/s32 on 'Bag'/'There's' (the fallback would cut on 'झूठ'/'Don't'), l29 s33/s34 on 'दामाद'/'did', the first word after the pause after 'अच्छा सुन...'/'Listen...'.

s33: S7 suggestion taken. lead.s33 5 (default) overrides silent_lead_s 0.6, and the 0.6 s sits as gap 'l36>l29' 18 frames before 'अच्छा सुन...'/'Listen...', while Aditya looks at the dabba a second too long.

Beat silences inside voiced shots: tail.s06 30 (b3 1.0 s after l04, the glass set down), tail.s13 30 (b4 1.0 s after l11, the clinks), tail.s17 36 (b5 1.2 s after l15). b9's 1.0 s before l33 is s26 silent_lead_s. Silent shots use their planned duration_s (s02, s04, s22, s25, s30, s35, s37, s38).
lead.s12 45: the SIM click and network chime (whole file, chime at 1.25 s) play before l10, as the cue sheet asks (between l09 and l10). lead.s31 8: Mausi's voice starts after the speaker tap.
tail.s32 22: en c055 'There's mathri in the side pocket of your bag.' read at 19.9 graphemes/s with the default tail (the cue cannot run past the s32/s33 cut). The same tail applies in hi.
s09 (hi 7.5 s) and s26 (en 8.1 s) run about 8 s: held on their shots.json camera moves (D-024 ruling 1 item 3 text), no other change.

voice_fx: phone (built-in) for Mausi on Billu's phone in the lane (l23, l35, l24, l25, l27). 'speaker' for Mausi on speaker in the room (l28, l36, l29, l30): lighter colour per the cue sheet, 200-5000 Hz band-pass, light tanh saturation and a 14 ms reflection at 0.12, loudness-matched to the clean take. Not listened to.

Sound levels are set against the files' measured levels (library manifest mean/max dB), as in s1e01: beds at 0 dB, mus_bed_drone gain_db -24 (s1e01's level), mus_tension_pulse -22 (its file is 2 dB quieter). Not listened to.

b2 and b4 clinks: sfx_bangle_slide_off has only one clear clink (file 2.05-2.45 s; the 0.45-0.85 s event is at bed level), so it is placed three times (library QC: 'S13 may need to reuse one'); b4 is 3 dB softer than b2.

b10: drone crossfades into mus_tension_pulse over 2 s centred on the cut to s30; the vibrate's second buzz is cut at s31.start, with the speaker tap (second tap of sfx_phone_set_down_sheet) on the cut. Bedroom bed -6 dB from l29; pulse a further -4 dB (with the -8 dB auto duck, about -12) under l29 and l30.
sfx_zip_pocket: about 20 dB under Mausi (file peak -37 dB). No panning in the toolchain, so it is not panned away from the phone as the cue sheet asks.

b13: Kiran's in-breath is the contingency cue sfx_s1e02_b13_inbreath (ElevenLabs sound v3, one take, sound/manifest.jsonl), placed at s38.start + 0.5s; there is no voice line or take for it. The file peaks at -30.5 dBFS. At db +10.5 the mastered renders put it at -10.8 dBFS (hi) / -10.1 dBFS (en) peak, about 9 dB above the cue gain (master loudnorm is about +3.7 dB of that), so it is db +5 (cue-sheet sfx gain 0) for about -16 dBFS peak in the mastered mix: clearly audible on a phone in the silent ending, well under the -1 dBTP master ceiling. The picture hard-cuts to black and silence at s38's end, 1.0 s into the 1.2 s file, so the breath's decaying tail is cut there; fade_out 2 frames keeps that cut from clicking. Music and the bedroom bed cut to silence on the cut to s38 (1-frame fade; 10 ms is under one frame), so the breath is the only sound in s38. Not checked by ear (sheet fallback: drop it and leave the silence).
sfx_car_door_clunk is left unplaced on purpose (cue sheet: library_cues_listed_for_s1e02_but_not_used). sfx_boots_concrete_shift (optional on the sheet) is placed low in the b12 still.
Series 1 plot text uses the measured clock and phone placements in shots.*.plot_text.
